name: Naga, Titan
body:
NAGA, TITAN
CR 10

XP 9,600
N Gargantuan aberration
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., echosight 40 ft.; Perception +25

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 7, flat-footed 27 (+9 armor, +1 Dex, +12 natural, –4 size)
hp 202 (15d8+135)
Fort +14, Ref +7, Will +16

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., climb 40 ft., swim 40 ft.
Melee longsword +19/+14/+9 (4d6+12/19–20), bite +17 (4d6+12)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks titan’s charge
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 9th; concentration +13)

Constant—echolocation, freedom of movement

Sorcerer Spells Known (CL 10th; concentration +13)

3rd (2/day)—fly, haste
2nd (2/day)—blood armor, mirror image, resist energy, see invisibility
1st (3/day)—bloodbath, endure elements, mirror strike, protection from evil, shield

STATISTICS

Str 35, Dex 15, Con 28, Int 16, Wis 24, Cha 17
Base Atk +11; CMB +27 (+31 grapple); CMD 39 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Eschew Materials, Furious Focus, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Multiattack, Power Attack, Snatch, Vital Strike
Skills Intimidate +21, Knowledge (arcana) +18, Knowledge (history) +21, Perception +25, Sense Motive +25, Survival +25
Languages Draconic
SQ battlemaster

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Battlemaster (Ex)

A titan naga is proficient with light, medium, and heavy armor, as well as all simple and martial weapons. Even though it lacks arms, the titan naga is capable of wielding a one-handed melee weapon of its size using its tail. A titan naga can make attacks of opportunity against creatures as small as Medium size.

Titan’s Charge (Ex)

While charging, a titan naga ignores difficult terrain and can make a single sunder attempt as a free action while charging to destroy an object in its way.

Spell Casting

A titan naga casts spells as a 10th-level bloodrager. It may cast arcane spells in heavy armor without incurring the arcane spell failure chance.

After lifetimes of proving themselves on the front lines, the greatest soldiers among the scaled ones are reborn as the tremendous titan naga. Wielding their favored armament in their new tail and retaining centuries of military training, titan naga rely upon their innate magic to boost their physical prowess rather than supplant it.

Passages

The Fantasmics survive through stories and their perpetuation, guiding mortals to eternally repeat archetypal myths so as to fortify the great facsimiles. Mortals cannot always play every role, however, leading the Fantasmics to create a variety of powerful avatars known as Passages.

Passages exist in various archetypal forms to ensure that myths take their proper course, guiding heroes on their prescribed paths and quashing those who would disrupt the structure of the narrative.

The Passage Subtype

Passages are native outsiders creating with energies from the shadow plane, created to emulate archetypal story roles.

They have the following traits (unless otherwise noted in a creature’s entry).

Passages may be of any alignment.

Covert (Ex)

Every passage appears to be a specific variety of creature (such as a predatory animal, a humanoid, or an angel) and gain a +10 bonus on Disguise checks to appear as a creature of that variety.

In addition, passages do not detect as outsiders when targeted by effects that discern creature type, instead appearing as a creature type of their choice.

Passages automatically succeed at Perception checks attempted to pierce the disguises of other passages and recognize them as passages.

Mastery of Tales (Ex)

Passages are immune to illusion effects and mind-affecting effects and can perceive through any illusion as though under a constant True Perception (sense) from the Divination sphere.

Shadow Shaper: Passages gain the shadowmark, shadowstuff, and create reality class features of a fey adept whose level equals the passage’s Hit Dice. A passage may choose to make a shadowmark permanent, although permanent shadowmarks do not deal damage and only apply penalties to saving throws against the abilities of passages. These shadowmarks can be removed by the break enchantment spell or similar effects. A passage may maintain a number of permanent shadowmarks up to their Charisma modifier.
Telepathy: This telepathy is rarely used to communicate with mortals, but is employed liberally to communicate with other passages to coordinate their actions.
